issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese. 'Can I keep a bottle here?' implies the speaker wants to store their own bottle, not use the bottle keep service.
issues.suggestion: Can I bottle keep? / Do you offer bottle keep?

issues.concern: The English translation misrepresents the Japanese. 'The bottle I kept from last time is still here' implies the speaker personally stored the bottle, not that it was bottle-kept by the establishment.
issues.suggestion: The bottle I bottle-kept last time is still here. / My bottle from last time is still here.
